startersHint: A starter picks how the new photo is revealed, the length, the title and the tags. Tap Try sample photos to see it work straight away.
photosHint: The before photo and the after photo. Take both from the same spot and angle so the change is easy to see.
readFailed: This photo could not be read. Try a JPG or PNG picture.
previewEmpty: Add both photos or try the sample photos to see the preview.
musicHint: Pick a song or sound from your device. It fades in and out. Use music you are allowed to use.
musicFailed: This sound file could not be read. Try an MP3, M4A or WAV file.
keepOpen: Keep this page open until it is done.
failed: The video could not be made. Try a smaller video size.
noRecord: This browser cannot save videos. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
mp4Note: Saved as an MP4 file that plays on phones, computers and WhatsApp.
webmNote: Saved as a WebM file because this browser cannot make MP4. It plays in most browsers.
notSaved: Your photos and video stay on this device and are never uploaded. Only your look choices are remembered in this browser.
photoCanvas: Preview of the before and after video
